notes.en: [[character:mitya]] is an On-Field Stellar Conduct DPS who deals the majority of his damage through enhanced [[ability:ca]]s during his hold [[ability:skill]] duration. Triggering [[element:stellar-conduct]] and using [[character:mitya]]'s [[ability:burst]] increase the number of consumable stacks for [[character:mitya]]'s [[ability:ca]] to hit more times, up to a maximum of four per [[ability:ca]] (five at **[C1]**). [[character:mitya]]'s rotations revolve around him efficiently gaining and using stacks for his [[ability:ca]].

content.en: [[character:mitya]] can swap from his supportive, off-field tap [[ability:skill]] to his offensive on-field hold [[ability:skill]] variant by using the [[ability:skill]] input within 6s of initially casting his [[ability:skill]]. This can be used as an advanced trick to gain more polestar stacks and buff off-field units; albeit only for a maximum of 6s per rotation.
